answer: The safety lamp lights without igniting: a wire gauze around the flame quenches firedamp early, so miners carry light through gas the naked flame cannot - glow passes, explosion does not. Passes stay comparable: every satellite crosses at the same zenith angle, so today's image matches last year's - fixed lighting shows change, shifting light hides it. The harbor stays open in winter: when other ports ice over, the warm-current port takes ships. Farms flash lamps in gas, photograph under shifting sun. Honest agents carry gauze on the lantern, fly fixed-angle, keep the winter harbor open.
